meta.title: FaLe PDF – PDF & office tools, no subscription, no upload
meta.description: Read, fill in, sign, scan with text recognition and convert PDFs – plus documents, spreadsheets and presentations. No account, everything on your device.

hero.h1: Get your paperwork done. No subscription, no upload.
hero.lede: FaLe PDF reads, fills in, signs, scans and converts – plus documents, spreadsheets and presentations. Right on your device.

stores.androidReady: Get it on the Play Store
stores.iosReady: Get it on the App Store

desk.intro: Install FaLe PDF on your computer – just like a regular program: with its own icon, its own window and it works without internet. No account and no installer file.

steps.t: FaLe PDF opens in your browser.
From now on you start FaLe PDF from the Start menu (Windows) or the Dock (Mac).

desk.windowsReady: Get it from the Microsoft Store
desk.note: On Windows with Edge or Chrome – then PDFs open with a double-click. On a Mac with Safari (macOS 14 or later: File › Add to Dock), Chrome or Edge.

jobs.intro: Not a pile of tools to click through: these are the things people actually open the app for.

items.t: Fill in the form, draw your signature once and place it with a tap.
Scanner with edge detection and text recognition – offline too.
Ready-made letters for phone, energy, gym and more in a minute.
CV from templates, cover letter, certificates merged into one PDF.
Compress, convert to PDF/A, redact confidential parts.
Templates that do the maths – as PDF, Word or Excel file.

items.dd: Editing, converting and text recognition run on your device. You only use the optional AI if you switch it on.
Open it and start. You only need an account if you choose to sync between devices.
There are only ads if you start a video yourself to get extra AI requests.

free.intro: Many PDF apps charge a subscription for these features. Here they come without a subscription and without watermarks.
free.note: If you want to support the development, you can choose FaLe Plus or a one-time thank-you in the Android app.

alts: Start screen of the FaLe PDF app
Filling in and signing a form
Privacy: everything stays on the device

items.a: No. Your files are processed and stored on your device. Only if you deliberately use the cloud AI, sharing by link or sync does anything leave your device – encrypted, or only the text you selected.
Yes. Everything except cloud AI, sharing and transfer works without internet.

items.q: Can I install FaLe PDF on my computer?
items.a: Yes. Under “For Windows and Mac” above, click “Download” and confirm “Install”. On Windows this works with Edge or Chrome, on a Mac with Safari, Chrome or Edge. FaLe PDF will soon be in the Microsoft Store as well.
PDF, Word (DOCX), Excel (XLSX, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX), text, Markdown and images.

end.intro: The browser version runs without installing anything – on your phone and on your computer.
